note: Exel Shatterbox was sold by Barnes & Mullins; surviving examples show distinct construction, but the exact factory is not established here.
By the mid-1970s B&M had discontinued the Exel pedals and was supplying a Fuzz Unit made by Sola Sound; retain B&M as marketed identity and Sola Sound as physical supplier.
Park was a Marshall-launched brand and its surviving Fuzz Sound examples are rebranded Sola Sound production; model variants should remain period-qualified.
Vox-branded MKII production was supplied by Sola Sound, with identifiable component-state changes across the production period.
Sola Sound continued supplying Vox with MKIII units into the 1970s; multiple circuit generations exist under the same marketed model name.
